title: D-Link DIR-X1860Z Flaws Enable Unauthenticated Admin Password Reset and Wi-Fi Credential Theft
content_md: D-Link has released a security update for the DIR-X1860Z router after researchers discovered vulnerabilities that could enable an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to reset the administrator password and retrieve wireless configuration information, including Wi-Fi credentials. The vulnerabilities affect the non-US DIR-X1860Z hardware revision A1/V1.0 running firmware version V1.0.2.220120.165402.
